text:
maria: Vendor pinged — EU h100 pool is currently oversubscribed. They're putting a soft-quota on non-prod projects starting ~2024-09-02 18:00 UTC. Anyone own proj-staging-12 / proj-demo-*? We should triage which workloads need protection.
jonathan: Is this soft-quota applied to spot-only or also affects standby/ephemeral? :thinking:
vendor-bot: [vendor update] soft-limit flag applied to projects matching proj-demo-* and proj-staging-12. Affected capacity: spot + standby fallback. Estimated lift: ~6 hours. https://vendor.portal/incidents/INC-6789
maria: Vendor says dedicated/reserved pools unaffected. Problem is autoscaler will backoff our non-protected tenants. Suggestion: add allocation tags so CI and short-lived jobs are deprioritized during the window.
devin: I can make a small TF change to tag staging/demo allocations. Snippet below (will push a branch):
```
resource "redwood_pool_allocation" "staging" {
  project = "proj-staging-12"
  allocation_tag = "avoid-eu-peak"
}
```
jonathan: Nice. Also update the quota_policy so test jobs prefer `allocation_preferences = ["avoid-eu-peak"]` — keeps them out of hot paths. I'll open the infra PR if devin wants me to.
tara: Can we canary this on a single tenant first? I'll run nightly smoke on proj-dev-9 with the tag and confirm behavior.
maria: Good call. @devin can you apply it only to proj-staging-12 first? I'll coordinate with vendor on protected list. vendor-bot — any chance you can mark any of our CI projects as protected to avoid soft-limits? :pray:
vendor-bot: We can protect up to 3 projects via a support ticket. Opening ticket now (ticket #6789). ETA for protection: ~2 hours.
jonathan: I created PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4123 — adds allocation_tag + quota_policy changes. Pinged reviewers @devin @sre.
devin: lgtm. I'll hold apply until vendor confirms protection. Planning terraform apply during quiet window ~21:00 UTC.
maria: Thanks all. I'll update this thread when ticket 6789 is resolved and after the canary smoke. If protection isn't granted in time we shift CI away from EU for tonight. :thumbsup:
